svg.title: Five Core Seats, Two Conditional Expansion Seats
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-five-to-seven-person-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: Five Core Seats, Two Conditional Expansion Seats; subtitle: Conservative and Base: 2 FT + 3 C; Scaled: 3 FT + 4 C.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Each stage describes one potential person. Numeric values show Base-Case active headcount: five ones and two zeros. Activate both expansion seats for the seven-person Scaled configuration. Estate counsel and title providers are external counterparties.; caption: The five-person pod supports the $120,000 Conservative and $510,000 Base revenue scenarios. The seven-person pod supports the $900,000 Scaled scenario; additional seats alone do not establish demand or commission production.; stages: label: Broker lead — FT; value: One core full-time owner of brokerage execution; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own agency relationships, listing strategy, negotiations, and brokerage supervision. Maintain a weekly exception review covering authority, disputes, and stalled transactions.; label: Operations lead — FT; value: One core full-time owner of pipeline control; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain docket alerts, CRM records, checklist versions, cash forecasts, and reporting. Escalate missing evidence rather than marking incomplete statutory tasks as finished.; label: Field brokerage support — C; value: One core contractor handling authorized licensed fieldwork; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Provide appropriately licensed showing, inspection-access, and market-support services within the brokerage's supervision. Confirm worker classification under applicable law.; label: Transaction coordinator — C; value: One core contractor maintaining transaction evidence; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Track deadlines, signatures, disclosures, and closing records. Administrative coordination does not authorize independent brokerage activity or interpretation of disputed estate powers.; label: Property vendor coordinator — C; value: One core contractor organizing property preparation; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Schedule authorized cleanouts, security checks, repairs, and photography. Keep vendor scopes and estate payment responsibility separate from operator commission accounting.; label: Additional licensed producer — FT; value: Zero Base seats; add one Scaled full-time producer; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Expand to three full-time people when collected revenue, active listings, and response-time pressure support the added fixed cost and supervisory workload.; label: Additional coordination support — C; value: Zero Base seats; add one Scaled contractor; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Expand to four contractors for greater docket, document, and vendor workload. Assign a defined service scope instead of creating overlapping ownership of deadlines.

text.title: Five Core Seats, Two Conditional Expansion Seats
text.tspan: Five Core Seats, Two Conditional Expansion Seats

rect.title: label: Broker lead — FT; value: One core full-time owner of brokerage execution; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own agency relationships, listing strategy, negotiations, and brokerage supervision. Maintain a weekly exception review covering authority, disputes, and stalled transactions.

text.title: Own agency relationships, listing strategy, negotiations, and brokerage supervision. Maintain a weekly exception review covering authority, disputes, and stalled transactions.

rect.title: label: Operations lead — FT; value: One core full-time owner of pipeline control; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain docket alerts, CRM records, checklist versions, cash forecasts, and reporting. Escalate missing evidence rather than marking incomplete statutory tasks as finished.

text.title: Maintain docket alerts, CRM records, checklist versions, cash forecasts, and reporting. Escalate missing evidence rather than marking incomplete statutory tasks as finished.

rect.title: label: Field brokerage support — C; value: One core contractor handling authorized licensed fieldwork; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Provide appropriately licensed showing, inspection-access, and market-support services within the brokerage's supervision. Confirm worker classification under applicable law.

text.title: Provide appropriately licensed showing, inspection-access, and market-support services within the brokerage's supervision. Confirm worker classification under applicable law.

rect.title: label: Transaction coordinator — C; value: One core contractor maintaining transaction evidence; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Track deadlines, signatures, disclosures, and closing records. Administrative coordination does not authorize independent brokerage activity or interpretation of disputed estate powers.

text.title: Track deadlines, signatures, disclosures, and closing records. Administrative coordination does not authorize independent brokerage activity or interpretation of disputed estate powers.

rect.title: label: Property vendor coordinator — C; value: One core contractor organizing property preparation; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Schedule authorized cleanouts, security checks, repairs, and photography. Keep vendor scopes and estate payment responsibility separate from operator commission accounting.

text.title: Schedule authorized cleanouts, security checks, repairs, and photography. Keep vendor scopes and estate payment responsibility separate from operator commission accounting.

rect.title: label: Additional licensed producer — FT; value: Zero Base seats; add one Scaled full-time producer; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Expand to three full-time people when collected revenue, active listings, and response-time pressure support the added fixed cost and supervisory workload.

text.title: Expand to three full-time people when collected revenue, active listings, and response-time pressure support the added fixed cost and supervisory workload.

rect.title: label: Additional coordination support — C; value: Zero Base seats; add one Scaled contractor; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Expand to four contractors for greater docket, document, and vendor workload. Assign a defined service scope instead of creating overlapping ownership of deadlines.

text.title: Expand to four contractors for greater docket, document, and vendor workload. Assign a defined service scope instead of creating overlapping ownership of deadlines.

Assumptions: Each stage describes one potential person. Numeric values show Base-Case active headcount: five ones and two zeros. Activate both expansion seats for the seven-person Scaled configuration. Estate counsel and title providers are external counterparties.
